review_evidence: All 123 current primary Rocq files in the core/theories/tutorial unit were inventoried. 53 own common declaration forms totaling about 1,773 declarations, including Corelib/Init/Logic.v, Init/Specif.v, Init/Nat.v, Classes/Morphisms.v and ssr/ssrbool.v.

The declaration-light remainder includes Ltac2 interfaces, extraction support, compatibility modules and plugin tutorial loaders. File role/name alone does not establish absence of reusable formal or tactic interfaces, so these were not blanket-excluded.
The unit mixes foundational logical definitions, primitive axioms/specifications, tactic-language interfaces and tutorials; no exact source-local selector was proven lossless.
summary: Retain the Rocq core library, Ltac2 interfaces and plugin tutorial formal sources; no hard exclusion was established losslessly for this mixed foundational unit.
